label: conflict_resolution_type setting (Sync Gateway ISGR/database replication)
type: the per-replication setting choosing how Sync Gateway resolves a write conflict. Values: "default", "remoteWins", "localWins", or "custom" (which requires custom_conflict_resolver to be set). Changing it is an Enterprise-Edition-only operation.
